g.aria-label: Gradient legend titled 'Similarity (%)' for fill color with values from 0 to 82
Symbol legend for fill color with 5 values: no tests, source tests, target tests, both tests, hand-written reference
Title text 'typescript → python: port against port'

Subtitle text 'Each cell is one pair: the port on its row read against the port on its column. Lower triangle prints the value, upper fills it as colour. The diagonal is left out, a port against itself being 100. Colour runs over the measured range, 0% to 82%. Strips on both headers carry the condition; the hand-written reference takes the last row and column.'
